T2M.description: Air temperature at 2 m, daily mean

T2M_MAX.description: Air temperature at 2 m, daily max

T2M_MIN.description: Air temperature at 2 m, daily min

GWETTOP.description: Surface soil wetness (0–5 cm), fraction of saturation

GWETROOT.description: Root-zone soil wetness (0–100 cm), fraction of saturation

GWETPROF.description: Profile soil wetness (surface to bedrock), fraction of saturation

notes: Missing values are empty cells in the CSVs (API fill value -999 removed).
GWETTOP/GWETROOT/GWETPROF are soil WETNESS as a fraction of saturation (0–1), not volumetric moisture %. Convert before comparing with the SENSOR reading.
Satellite/model grid cell (~0.5° × 0.625°, MERRA-2): it represents the region, not the plot.
Last days may be missing because of POWER data latency; they are trimmed.
